summary.text: Paul Johnson is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 74, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Chanz Green. Ballotpedia lists him as a former member of the Spooner Area School District board.

paragraphs.text: Paul Johnson is listed by Ballotpedia as a prior officeholder on the Spooner Area School District board, in an at-large seat.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Assembly District 74 on August 11, 2026, with 5,716 votes in an uncontested race.
